Name of the Post
Number of post
Applications are invited for the post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF), on a purely
temporary (co-terminus with the project) basis in our DST Research Project entitled "Indian
Participation in the CMS Experiment at CERN: Maintenance, Operation and Utilization".
Elligibility
Emoluments
University Institute of Engineering and Technology
South Campus, Sector -25, Panjab University,
Chandigarh
Termination
ADVERTISEMENT
Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
One (1)
Essesntial: M.Sc. Physics / M.Sc. Physics & Electronics with
55% marks, NET/GATE qualified.
Preferred: Preference will be given to candidate who is
planning to pursue Ph.D. with the fellowship
Rs. 37,000 pm + HRA (NET/GATE qualified)
J8l1126
Co-terminus with the project. Fellowship can terminated earlier as
well, in case non-statisfactory performance.
Applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data and copies of marks sheets and
relevant certificates should be sent to Dr. Sunil Bansal, Project Coordinator, Department of
Applied Science, UIET Panjab University, Chandigarh within 20 days of the advertisement by
email: sbansal@pu.ac.in. Shortlisted candidates, for interview, will be informed by email.
(Dr. Sunil Bansal)
Project Coordinator,
DST Research Project.
